Claim 15 (Currently Amended): A method for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers, the method comprising the steps of: adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; __providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer__; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker selects the first server computer based on load balancing criteria__.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 16, __wherein the media request broker analyzes server performance metrics before selecting the first server computer__, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, __further comprising at least temporarily storing the information added to the locator on a dedicated storage system separate from the web application server__.

Claim 24 (Currently Amended): A system for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers, the system comprising: circuitry for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; __circuitry for providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer__; and circuitry for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

Claim 25 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 24, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker includes circuitry for selecting the first server computer based on load balancing criteria__.

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): A computer program product for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers, the computer program product comprising: a program step of adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; __a program step of providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer__; and a program step of selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

Claim 28 (Currently Amended): The computer program product of claim 27, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the computer program product further comprising the program step of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker includes a program step for selecting the first server computer based on load balancing criteria__.
